notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-1). The task tool runs as a child session_v2 row with parent_id set; the daemon links it (parent_linked) and the parent's turn — blocked on the open task tool — ends on its own Stop hook after the child has finished.

text: The parent API session is admitted on its first activity: a ses_… transcript_new
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The prompt drives the parent to working
The task tool's child session row is admitted on its own activity: a NEW ses_… transcript_new
The detector links the child to the parent (session_v2.parent_id → ParentSessionID); the parent's subagent count reads 1
The child's work completes and it settles in ready (subagent count drops to 0)
Only after the child reported back does the parent's own turn end: its session.execution.succeeded (Stop)
The parent goes working → ready after the child — it did not end its turn while the child was alive
